name: property tax appeals

product.purpose: Prepare evidence packets and customer-reviewed postcard proofs from county public records and customer supplied notices and comparable sales.
product.first_county_choice: Cook County, Illinois; homeowner self-file assist for an individual taxpayer filing for themselves.
product.filing_policy: For Cook County, an individual homeowner reviews the evidence packet, chooses the review stage, signs, and files personally through the county portal. Glacier prepares evidence and instructions only; it does not represent anyone or file.
product.billing: Owner confirms a flat packet fee before any checkout is enabled; no contingency billing is enabled.

schedules.purpose: Refresh the public Cook County assessor parcel roll each day and keep source alerts visible.

secrets_needed: LOB_API_KEY (optional test key only; rendering local proofs needs no key)

your_steps.title: Confirm the Cook County homeowner self-file scope
your_steps.when: Before enabling customer cases, after the local packet flow is verified
your_steps.detail: Keep launch disabled for new customer cases until a successful end-to-end local packet-flow run is verified and the owner confirms the two-step Cook County scope. Current Assessor rules allow pro se filing; Board rules allow an individual taxpayer to file pro se for property titled in their own name. Glacier prepares the evidence packet and guide; the homeowner files personally. See the official Assessor and Board rules.

your_steps.title: Optional — Future Texas expansion (not required for Cook County launch)
your_steps.when: Before adding any Texas county or providing paid representation there
your_steps.detail: Optional future expansion, not needed for Cook County homeowner self-file. Before adding Texas, review eligibility and current requirements at https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/ptc/ and its official application. Do not enable Texas cases until any required registration and association are completed by the owner. Glacier does not create an account, enter personal information, sign, or pay.

your_steps.title: Optional: review a local postcard proof
your_steps.when: Before the first external mailing in each county or with each new card design
your_steps.detail: Optional marketing step, not required for Cook County homeowner self-file. Review the exact local proof under $GLACIER_HOME/ventures/property-tax/postcards and its do-not-mail status. Live mailing remains disabled. Any future external mailing requires a separate owner decision and approval for the exact recipient list, design, sender, and spend. This build only renders local proofs and never sends to real recipients.

launch_gates: Keep launch disabled for new customer cases until a successful end-to-end local packet-flow run is verified and the owner confirms the Cook County homeowner self-file scope.
Paid checkout stays disabled until the owner confirms packet pricing; it is not required for local packet preparation.
Live mailing stays disabled; postcard flow renders local proofs only.
Texas work is optional future expansion and stays disabled until the owner completes any required consultant registration.
Every customer reviews, signs, and submits their own county filing; Glacier does not file appeals.
